Title: Successful password reset with minimum valid length (8 characters)
Preconditions: User has a registered account with email 'user@example.com'.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Forgot Password page.
2. Enter 'user@example.com' and click 'Send'.
3. Open the reset link from the received email.
4. Enter 'NewPass1' (8 characters, 1 number) as the new password.
5. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: System confirms email sent; User receives email; New password is accepted; User can log in with new credentials.

Title: Successful password reset with maximum valid length (20 characters)
Preconditions: User has a registered account and has received a valid reset link via email.
Steps:
1. Open the reset link from the email.
2. Enter 'A1bcdefghijlkmnopqrs' (20 characters, includes numbers).
3. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: System confirms password change; Password 'A1' followed by 18 characters is accepted.

Title: Password reset fails if password is less than 8 characters
Preconditions: User has a registered account and has received a valid reset link via email.
Steps:
1. Open the reset link from the email.
2. Enter 'Passw1' (6 characters).
3. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: System displays an error message stating the password must be at least 8 characters long.

Title: Password reset fails if password is more than 20 characters
Preconditions: User has a registered account and has received a valid reset link via email.
Steps:
1. Open the reset link from the email.
2. Enter 'PasswordLongerThan20Chars1' (26 characters).
3. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: System displays an error message stating the password cannot exceed 20 characters.

Title: Password reset fails if password contains no numbers
Preconditions: User has a registered account and has received a valid reset link via email.
Steps:
1. Open the reset link from the email.
2. Enter 'PasswordNoNum' (13 characters, no numbers).
3. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: System displays an error message stating the password must contain at least one number.

Title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
Preconditions: User has a registered account and requested a reset link.
Steps:
1. Request a password reset link.
2. Wait for 31 minutes without clicking the link.
3. Click the link in the email.
Expected Result: System displays an error message: 'The reset link has expired.'

Title: Password reset request with unregistered email address
Preconditions: User is on the Forgot Password page. 'nonexistent@example.com' is not in the database.
Steps:
1. Enter 'nonexistent@example.com' in the email field.
2. Click 'Send Link'.
3. Check inbox of 'nonexistent@example.com'.
Expected Result: System displays a message (e.g., 'If your email is in our system, you will receive a link') and no email is sent to the provided address.

Title: Reset link cannot be reused after successful password change
Preconditions: User has already successfully reset their password using Link A.
Steps:
1. Attempt to click Link A again from the email.
2. Attempt to provide a new password and submit.
Expected Result: System displays an error message: 'This link has already been used.'

Title: Password with mixed characters (uppercase/special) and numbers is accepted
Preconditions: User has a registered account and a valid reset link.
Steps:
1. Open the reset link from the email.
2. Enter 'Password123!' (contains uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols).
3. Click 'Reset Password'.
Expected Result: Password is successfully reset; 'Password123!' is accepted.

Title: Reset link is still valid just before 30-minute expiration
Preconditions: User has a registered account and requested a reset link.
Steps:
1. Request a password reset link.
2. Wait for 29 minutes.
3. Click the link in the email.
Expected Result: Link is still active; password reset form is displayed.
